overview.description: Centralized resource hub for current and prospective CSULB graduate students.
audiences: CSULB undergraduates and alumni considering graduate school

advising.name: Graduate School Advising
advising.description: Application guidance, statement of purpose review, CV/resume review, program selection support.
advising.scope_note: Does NOT cover course registration, scheduling, or graduation requirements — contact your department's graduate advisor for those.

policies.cancellation: Cancel at least 24 hours in advance
policies.late_arrival: 15+ minutes late may result in cancellation

advising.materials_feedback: Submit via Program Materials Feedback form; allow 2–3 weeks for response

writing_support.name: Graduate Writing Support
writing_support.description: Free 1:1 writing appointments for enrolled CSULB graduate students.

statement_of_purpose_help.name: Statement of Purpose Guidance
resources: Sample PhD political science statement with expert commentary
Interdisciplinary sample statements from CSU Channel Islands
Tips and handouts from graduate writing specialists

document_types.traditional_cv: 20+ pages, used by established scholars; not typically used for grad applications
document_types.grad_school_cv: Preferred 2–3 page CV-résumé hybrid with bullet points per position

gradmentor.name: GradMentor
gradmentor.description: Peer mentoring program connecting incoming graduate students with experienced peers.
gradmentor.meeting_frequency: 1–2 times per month during the academic year

eligibility.mentees: All incoming CSULB graduate students (master's, credential, certificate, doctoral)
eligibility.mentors: Continuing graduate students in any program type

grad_slam.name: Grad Slam
grad_slam.description: 3-minute research presentation competition for CSULB graduate students.
eligibility: Currently enrolled CSULB master's or doctoral student
Original, independent research or graduate project

format.visual: Single slide only (no transitions or animations)
format.submission: Public-facing URL from Zoom, YouTube, or Vimeo

writing_retreat.name: Graduate Writing Retreat
writing_retreat.description: Full-day writing retreat held in April–May.

workshops_events.name: Workshops & Events
workshops_events.open_to: Entire campus community including undergraduates, graduates, and the public
workshops_events.registration: Most workshops require Zoom or Qualtrics registration; drop-in sessions need no registration.

mental_health_intern.name: Mental Health Intern Consultations
mental_health_intern.description: Mental health intern consultations available for graduate students.

statistical_consulting.name: Statistical Consulting Program
statistical_consulting.description: Statistical consulting for graduate-level research projects.

cal_state_apply_guide.name: Navigating the Cal State Apply Portal

related_resources.funding: See funding.json for travel grants, fellowships, and external scholarships
related_resources.milestones_and_thesis: See milestones_thesis.json for thesis/dissertation submission deadlines
